subject: nereid-v8-hourglass
q: CLOSED — the gate was the problem, and it has been replaced.
detail:
The Archive said that a calibration instrument rejecting its own reference standard has a problem in the instrument. THE INSTRUMENT WAS CHANGED.

bust÷hips within 0.95–1.05 is withdrawn. The rule is now |WHR − WBR| ≤ 0.10 — the unrounded gap between two ratios taken off the same finished waist. BELLA PASSES AT 0.0913, keeps her forty-six-inch hips, and has nothing silently enlarged.

THE SURVEY, RERUN: three of thirty-two passed the old gate. TWENTY-EIGHT PASS THE NEW LAW.
